<html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
<html:p>So. Somehow it's the end of November. Where has the time gone? Apparently
having <html:a href="/202512/2025-in-review">a job</html:a>, working on <html:a href="https://godbolt.org/">Compiler Explorer</html:a>, and
<html:a href="https://github.com/mattgodbolt/seasocks">lots</html:a> <html:a href="https://github.com/mattgodbolt/zindex">of</html:a>
<html:a href="https://github.com/mattgodbolt/jsbeeb">other</html:a> <html:a href="https://github.com/mattgodbolt/Miracle">side</html:a>
<html:a href="https://github.com/mattgodbolt/PALindrome">projects</html:a> has made the year go by quickly!</html:p>

<html:p>In my travels with my employer, <html:a href="https://www.hudsonrivertrading.com/">HRT</html:a>, this year I've been to many conferences,
meetups, and universities. The thing I'm most asked is: "Will there be an
Advent of Compiler Optimisations this year?"</html:p>

<html:p>So far I've replied that, sorry, no, I can't: I just don't have the time. Each
of those videos, the research, the writing, the recording, the editing, and the
rest of the YouTube stuff, took like <html:a href="/202512/2025-in-review">10 hours per episode</html:a><html:sup id="fnref:but"><html:a class="footnote-ref" href="#fn:but">1</html:a></html:sup>. I don't have that
kind of time.</html:p>

<html:p>But...I <html:strong>do</html:strong> want to do something. So! I am announcing the Advent of Microarchitecture 2026!
I'm recording straight to camera with little or no prep, and then using a light touch on editing
and fixing in post-production (with a little help from an LLM). All the content is me talking
directly to camera, ad-libbing, and then the process of turning that into something uploadable
is automated as much as I can.</html:p>

<html:p>So: don't expect too much, it's very low effort, but hopefully you'll enjoy it anyway! The
introduction video is <html:a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00KJ8h5QXcE">now up</html:a> (<html:a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLN7owJBX-Fcc">playlist here</html:a>), and you can subscribe to my channel <html:a href="https://www.youtube.com/mattgodbolt">here</html:a><html:sup id="fnref:like"><html:a class="footnote-ref" href="#fn:like">2</html:a></html:sup> to ensure you
don't miss them when they come out each morning!</html:p>

<html:div class="footnote">
<html:hr />
<html:ol>
<html:li id="fn:but">
<html:p>Even though I said 8 hours in the video... <html:a class="footnote-backref" href="#fnref:but" title="Jump back to footnote 1 in the text">↩</html:a></html:p>
</html:li>
<html:li id="fn:like">
<html:p>"Don't forget to like and subscribe!"... what is become of me? <html:a class="footnote-backref" href="#fnref:like" title="Jump back to footnote 2 in the text">↩</html:a></html:p>
</html:li>
</html:ol>
</html:div>

    </html:div>
content_text: So. Somehow it's the end of November. Where has the time gone? Apparently having a job , working on Compiler Explorer , and lots of other side projects has made the year go by quickly! In my travels with my employer, HRT , this year I've been to many conferences, meetups, and universities. The thing I'm most asked is: "Will there be an Advent of Compiler Optimisations this year?" So far I've replied that, sorry, no, I can't: I just don't have the time. Each of those videos, the research, the writing, the recording, the editing, and the rest of the YouTube stuff, took like 10 hours per episode 1 . I don't have that kind of time. But...I do want to do something. So! I am announcing the Advent of Microarchitecture 2026! I'm recording straight to camera with little or no prep, and then using a light touch on editing and fixing in post-production (with a little help from an LLM). All the content is me talking directly to camera, ad-libbing, and then the process of turning that into something uploadable is automated as much as I can. So: don't expect too much, it's very low effort, but hopefully you'll enjoy it anyway! The introduction video is now up ( playlist here ), and you can subscribe to my channel here 2 to ensure you don't miss them when they come out each morning! Even though I said 8 hours in the video... ↩ "Don't forget to like and subscribe!"... what is become of me? ↩
summary: In which I introduce an ill-advised, last-minute video series
title: Advent of Microarchitecture 2026
